title: Bloodstained Gallery
description: A man in a dark shirt stands before a large surreal painting in a dilapidated art gallery, blood pooling at his feet and dripping from the canvas. Rain pours through the broken ceiling as a crowd of onlookers with flashlights gathers in the background among scattered frames and debris.
prompt: A lone man stands in a ruined art gallery at night, staring at a massive surreal horror painting with melting faces, screaming mouths, and dripping crimson blood that pools on the floor. Rain falls through the destroyed ceiling, dramatic spotlight from a fallen lamp illuminates the scene, crowd of people with flashlights watching from the shadows, scattered broken frames and wilted flowers, moody cinematic atmosphere, highly detailed digital painting
